Hearing On Order To Show Cause For Change Of Name.
Off Calendar Jul-03-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: July 3, 2008

This matter was added to today's calendar for hearing on Change of Name due to a clerical error on Tuesday, July 1, 2008.
Dept. 218, Judge Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Zhi Cheng Li was present in pro per, placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Joe Zhi Cheng Li.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
